'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Mark Peterson LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Peterson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)|Local Uprising (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
